comparisons.peer_topic: Business Segment Structure and Reporting Basis
comparisons.peer_summary: Bank of America reports results through four business segments (Consumer Banking, GWIM, Global Banking, Global Markets) with remaining operations in All Other, managing and reporting on an FTE basis.
comparisons.comparison: Both JPMorgan and Bank of America disclosed their business segment structures in 2024, but they differed in the number of reportable segments and the nature of their recent changes. JPMorgan reduced its segment count by merging two entities into the Commercial & Investment Bank, resulting in three reportable segments. Bank of America, conversely, maintained a four-segment structure (Consumer Banking, GWIM, Global Banking, and Global Markets) with no indication of recent mergers or reorganizations in 2024, managing and reporting results on a full-time equivalent (FTE) basis compared to JPMorgan's LOB basis.

sentences.text: Effective in the second quarter of 2024, the Firm reorganized its reportable business segments by combining the former Corporate & Investment Bank and Commercial Banking business segments to form one reportable segment, the Commercial & Investment Bank ("CIB").

As a result of the reorganization, the Firm has three reportable business segments - Consumer & Community Banking, Commercial & Investment Bank, and Asset & Wealth Management - with the remaining activities in Corporate.
We report our results of operations through the following four business segments: Consumer Banking, GWIM, Global Banking and Global Markets, with the remaining operations recorded in All Other.
We manage our segments and report their results on an FTE basis.

comparisons.peer_topic: Completion of Organizational Simplification and New Structure
comparisons.peer_summary: In the first quarter of 2024, Citi completed its organizational simplification announced in September 2023, establishing a simpler management structure to align with strategy and improve accountability. The changes eliminated three legacy operating segments and consolidated regions from four to two, resulting in five new reportable operating segments (Services, Markets, Banking, Wealth, and U.S. Personal Banking) and a new financial reporting structure.
comparisons.comparison: Both JPMorgan and Citi completed significant organizational restructuring and segment redefinition in 2024. JPMorgan combined its Corporate & Investment Bank and Commercial Banking into a single Commercial & Investment Bank segment effective Q2 2024, resulting in three reportable segments. Similarly, Citi completed an organizational simplification in Q1 2024 that eliminated legacy segments and established five new reportable operating segments (Services, Markets, Banking, Wealth, and U.S. Personal Banking) to align with its strategy. Both companies used this year to simplify management structures and realign reporting with strategic goals.

sentences.text: Effective in the second quarter of 2024, the Firm reorganized its reportable business segments by combining the former Corporate & Investment Bank and Commercial Banking business segments to form one reportable segment, the Commercial & Investment Bank ("CIB").

As a result of the reorganization, the Firm has three reportable business segments - Consumer & Community Banking, Commercial & Investment Bank, and Asset & Wealth Management - with the remaining activities in Corporate.
During the first quarter of 2024, Citi completed its organizational simplification announced in September 2023.

Citi's operating model changes included elimination of the Institutional Clients Group, Personal Banking and Wealth Management and Legacy Franchises operating segments and resulted in the five current reportable operating segments-Services, Markets, Banking, Wealth and U.S. Personal Banking-and a new financial reporting structure.

comparisons.peer_summary: Effective in Q2 2024, Citi reclassified prior periods to align with organizational simplification, transferring the winding-down U.K. retail banking business from Wealth to Legacy Franchises within All Other.
comparisons.comparison: While JPMorgan’s Q2 2024 segment change was a forward-looking structural combination, Citi’s Q2 2024 actions involved reclassifying prior periods to conform to its organizational simplification. JPMorgan reorganized by combining two major banks into one, whereas Citi specifically transferred its winding-down U.K. retail banking business from Wealth to Legacy Franchises within All Other to align with its simplified structure. Both disclosures reflect the execution phase of broader 2024 organizational changes, but the specific operational adjustments differed in nature (merger of active segments vs. reclassification of winding-down legacy units).

comparisons.comparison: Both JPMorgan and Goldman Sachs reported results through three primary business segments in 2024. However, JPMorgan arrived at this three-segment structure through an active reorganization in Q2 2024 that combined the Corporate & Investment Bank and Commercial Banking. In contrast, Goldman Sachs maintained its three-segment structure (Global Banking & Markets, Asset & Wealth Management, and Platform Solutions) without indicating a recent merger or combination of these specific segments in 2024; its disclosure presents the structure as a stable reporting basis rather than a new reorganization outcome.
